prompts.boss: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent animated boss sprite sheet for a friendly chibi fantasy productivity RPG. Create exactly TWELVE animation poses of the same DREADROOT SENTINEL: a bulky ancient moss-covered stone golem, dark slate-blue rock body, chunky stone fists, two short branch-like horns, tiny glowing violet eyes and a bright amethyst crystal core in its chest, little green leaves on shoulders, powerful but cute, full body facing three-quarter LEFT toward the player. Rich polished pixel-art sprite style with crisp pixel clusters and dark outlines. Exactly THREE columns and FOUR rows in a regular grid on a PORTRAIT 3:4 canvas. Each equal square cell contains one centered complete pose with same body scale and foot baseline near bottom 82 percent. Leave ample transparent gutter and at least 10 percent margin inside each cell. Row 1 = idle: neutral, slight breathing rise, neutral blink. Row 2 = enraged idle: crystal brighter, shoulders lifted, purple energy accents around fists; three distinct small pulse poses. Row 3 = taking a hit: small purple-white impact burst on chest, recoil leaning right, recovering upright; always keep full golem visible. Row 4 = defeat: kneels with cracked crystal, slumps into chunky stones with fading glow, final small quiet pile of mossy stones and dim crystal. No gore. Effects stay INSIDE their own cells. Actual transparent alpha background, no black background, no environment, no floor, no shadow disk, no text or numbers, no grid lines, no watermark. This is one boss sprite atlas, not a character collection.
prompts.arena: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 4:3 landscape battle arena background for a chibi pixel-art mobile RPG. Create an ANCIENT FOREST GUILD ARENA, a mossy stone courtyard beneath enormous old trees with emerald canopies, ruined carved pillars at far edges, warm sunbeams and tiny violet crystals at the very far back. Foreground must have TWO clearly defined flat round stone battle platforms: a smaller player platform on the LEFT at x24%, and a slightly larger boss platform on the RIGHT at x76%, both centered vertically around y79%, connected by a clear flat floor. The middle foreground is clear so a projectile can travel from left to right. Fixed frontal side-battle camera, visually shallow depth, lovely legible game environment, muted background contrast so sprites stand out. Pixel-art texture with clear clustered pixels, harmonious with cute fantasy companions. Absolutely NO characters, no monster, no animals, no floating HUD, no lettering, no labels, no watermark, no borders. Opaque full-bleed background.
